words.definition: of unclear meaning; something that can be understood in more than one way
words.example: The men received an ambiguous message from their boss.
words.zh: 意義不明確的；可以用多種方式理解的東西

words.definition: an action or decision made with little thought, order, or reason
words.example: Her choice of clothing seemed arbitrary.
words.zh: 未經思考、命令或理由而做出的行動或決定

words.definition: to express or defend oneself strongly; to state positively
words.example: The government asserted its control over the banking system.
words.zh: 強烈表達或捍衛自己；積極地陳述

words.example: The scientists made an astounding discovery.
He was an astute worker, finishing in half the time it took the others to finish.

words.definition: to have the same opinion or draw the same conclusion
words.example: The director concurred with the conclusions of the committee's report.
words.zh: 持相同的意見或得出相同的結論

words.definition: making something appear true or good when it is false or bad
words.example: The magician deceptively made the rabbit disappear.
words.zh: 當某件事是假的或壞的時候，使其顯得真實或好

words.definition: to specify, name, or select to do a task; to indicate
words.example: The president designated the vice president to represent him at the meeting.
words.zh: 指定、命名或選擇執行任務；表明

words.definition: strong in one's opinion, firm in conviction, to find out
words.example: They were determined to go to graduate school.
words.zh: 堅持自己的觀點，堅定信念，找出答案

words.definition: to get the facts or draw out the truth
words.example: A lawyer will elicit all the facts necessary to prove her case.

words.definition: to be a good example of a concept or idea
words.example: The constitution is an embodiment of American ideals.
words.zh: 成為概念或想法的好例子

words.definition: to cause a conflict or argument
words.example: No one knew who had instigated the demonstration.
The student's mundane summer job frustrated her.
Canada petitioned the United Nations to consider its case.
The troubled executive relinquished her control of the company.

words.definition: strong enough to recover from difficulty or disease
words.example: She has a resilient personality and will soon feel better.
words.zh: 夠堅強，能夠從困難或疾病中恢復過來

words.example: The stagnant water was a perfect home for frogs.
